observations: Three clearly separate fossil cards A jaw, B broad bilateral pelvis with central sacral/opening region, C skull; generic stylized anatomy is coherent at overview level, without an identifiable species or anatomical measuring claim.

Older-to-younger arrow communicates chronology. Large explicit Abfolge ≠ Abstammung prevents treating chronology as a proved ancestor chain. The separate dotted branching hypothesis with question marks is tentative, not a linear ape-to-human ladder.
No actual dates, measured cranial volumes or species identification are claimed by the color bars. The image cannot itself substantiate fossil chronology or a particular phylogeny.
Friendly abstract comic landscape, thinking person and isolated cards; no open actor-facing notebook or backward writing, no water device or helix to inspect.

At the actual 360 rendering, the central distinction, fossil motifs, A/B/C and older-to-younger direction remain understandable. Small Hypothese is secondary: dotted branching/question marks communicate uncertainty without requiring that small word. 680 is clear, no cropping or horizontal overflow.

An adult demonstrates mulch gardening to a youth on the left; the youth passes a watering practice to another child on the right. Lernen plus Weitergeben/Verändern depicts socially transmitted, changeable practice rather than a hereditary skill.

The standalone lower Vererbung DNA symbol is visually separate from the learning arrow and human action. It does not show a DNA-to-learning arrow or acquired gardening being inherited. Its distinct label supports comparison, while a caption should make the biological-versus-cultural distinction explicit.

The DNA ribbons continue as coherent alternating sinuous strands at the two crossings, including the parts inferred behind the foreground ribbon. Rungs lie between the strands; no fork, impossible hidden restart, isolated backbone end or localized geometry fault observed in the actual original and display images.

The watering-can handle/spout, hand action and water flow toward plants are plausible. Rain barrel/downpipe and a low horizontal blue level in the dry-ground/sun inset communicate limited water, without a scale, quantitative result or saline-water claim.
Friendly abstract comic 16:9-like landscape; signs are general viewer-facing labels, not an actor-facing open notebook. Actor actions and object orientations are plausible.

At actual 360, Lernen, Weitergeben/Verändern and Vererbung, both people-to-people scenes and the low-water inset remain recognizable; fine DNA rungs/garden details are illustrative, not required tiny instructions. At 680 these details are clear. No cropping or horizontal overflow.
